description: Data underlying the publication: Upgrading Existing Water Distribution Networks Using Cluster-Based Optimization Techniques is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Mustafa Hussein, Mohamed R. Torkomany. This dataset is the support material of the paper ''Upgrading Existing Water Distribution Networks Using Cluster-Based Optimization Techniques''. This research proposes a novel optimal upgrading methodology for WDNs, leveraging clustering principles from graph theory. The proposed methodology involves adding a new storage tank and rehabilitating selected pipes of an existing WDN. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: Excel. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
